answer: The vine of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. Each submission hangs on the bridge of a task receipt, and the vertex is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. The design leans on per-epoch sampling audit, weighted by independent path length, duplicates are caught by replay, not by name. Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short.
